readme: Which AlertType members the end-to-end goldens actually pin, and which they do not. Written down because nine green clip goldens read like full coverage and are not: across all nine the union of pinned alert types is only driver_changed, drowsiness_unreliable, face_lost, yawn. microsleep and perclos_high - the two alerts this product exists to raise - appear in none of them, so before the synthetic golden below existed, a change that made MICROSLEEP permanently unreachable passed every clip green. Neither golden is ground truth; both pin BEHAVIOUR. tests/test_state.py::test_the_alert_coverage_ledger_tells_the_truth recomputes every flag in this file from the fixtures themselves, so it cannot go stale silently.
clip_goldens: tests/replay/golden/*.json - nine dashcam clips through the real pipeline on the GPU
synthetic_golden: tests/replay/golden/synthetic/scripted_drive.json - a scripted DriverSignals stream through the real DriverMonitor, no video and no models
why_the_clips_cannot_reach_the_drowsines: The nine replay clips are dashcam montages of other people's cars, not cabin footage (tests/replay/CLIPS.md). Nobody in them holds their eyes shut at the camera, wears sunglasses on purpose, holds a phone, or looks away for long enough; and no clip is replayed from a calibrated profile, so gaze-derived alerts are suppressed by design (tests/test_app_integration.py::test_goldens_record_the_uncalibrated_posture).
what_is_still_not_proven: Reachability is not accuracy. The synthetic golden proves the state machine still turns a closed-eye SIGNAL into a MICROSLEEP at the right instant. Nothing in this repository proves the perception layer produces that signal from a real closed eye: there is no cabin clip and no labelled eye closure here, and the EAR/MAR thresholds are documented starting points, not calibrations (see the header comments in dms/geometry/ear.py and dms/geometry/mar.py). Closing that needs footage, not code.

camera_fail.note: Raised by dms/app.py from the capture supervisor, never by DriverMonitor, so it cannot appear in a replay that ran to completion. Its UPSTREAM trigger is covered - tests/test_supervisor.py::test_error_emits_one_sentinel_and_a_camera_fail_enter_edge - but no test asserts the AlertEvent dms/app.py emits from it.

disk_full.note: Raised by dms/io/events.py and dms/io/clips.py on ENOSPC, never by DriverMonitor. Genuinely covered by a unit test that asserts the AlertType.DISK_FULL event - tests/test_events.py::test_enospc_does_not_raise_emits_disk_full_and_keeps_the_process_alive - just not by a golden, because a replay never fills the disk.
disk_full.why_unpinned: Raised by dms/io/events.py and dms/io/clips.py on ENOSPC, never by DriverMonitor. Genuinely covered by a unit test that asserts the AlertType.DISK_FULL event - tests/test_events.py::test_enospc_does_not_raise_emits_disk_full_and_keeps_the_process_alive - just not by a golden, because a replay never fills the disk.

distraction.note: Pinned end to end by the synthetic golden ONLY - it never fires on the nine clips. The nine replay clips are dashcam montages of other people's cars, not cabin footage (tests/replay/CLIPS.md). Nobody in them holds their eyes shut at the camera, wears sunglasses on purpose, holds a phone, or looks away for long enough; and no clip is replayed from a calibrated profile, so gaze-derived alerts are suppressed by design (tests/test_app_integration.py::test_goldens_record_the_uncalibrated_posture).

driver_changed.note: Pinned end to end by both the nine clip goldens (real pipeline, real engines) and the synthetic golden.

drowsiness_unreliable.note: Pinned end to end by both the nine clip goldens (real pipeline, real engines) and the synthetic golden.

engine_fail.note: Raised by dms/app.py when a TensorRT engine fails to load or an inference raises. NOT COVERED BY ANY TEST: the only occurrence of the name under tests/ is a manifest string assertion in tests/test_manifest.py. This is a real hole, not a structural impossibility, and it is written down here rather than left implied.

thermal_throttle.note: Raised by dms/app.py from tegrastats. The predicate is covered by tests/test_health.py::test_thermal_throttle_thresholds and the Prometheus counter by tests/test_metrics.py; the AlertEvent itself is not, and the board cannot be made to throttle on demand.
